caption: The drawing features an architectural structure consisting of a tall, fluted column mounted on a rectangular base that extends outward on both sides, forming two sets of stairs. The column is topped with an ornate, decorative finial. The main part of the drawing is rendered in shades of yellow, gray, and brown, using both pencil and colored pencil, with shading to indicate light and depth. To the left of the main structure is a simpler, smaller line drawing of the same structure, including a labeled scale in inches beneath it. The composition is set against a plain, off-white background within a bordered rectangular frame. The artist’s signature appears in the bottom right corner.
title: Andiron
